request.purpose: We plan hospital capacity and care pathways for the coming years and need the regional disease burden.
request.question: How many adults with type 2 diabetes receive neither an SGLT2 inhibitor nor a GLP-1 agonist, by hospital?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
SGLT2 inhibitor = ATC code starting with A10BK.
GLP-1 agonist = ATC code starting with A10BJ.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per hospital: adults with type 2 diabetes, how many of them have neither an active SGLT2 inhibitor nor an active GLP-1 agonist, and that share in %, one decimal.
